title: RecursiveMAS: ранняя остановка и бюджет пилота RunPod
summary: Невыполненный план learned early exit поверх frozen RecursiveMAS. Оценка RunPod: 58–118 A100-80GB GPU-hours по $1.79/h, $104–211 compute, около $166–327 с 50% резервом и $10 storage; рабочий бюджет $200–400. Часы — предположения до пилота, расход не утверждён. Критерий: реальная экономия времени при заданной границе потери качества.

claims.text: Небольшой gate, обученный на состояниях frozen RecursiveMAS, может уменьшить среднее время относительно фиксированных трёх раундов, сохраняя качество в заранее заданной non-inferiority margin. Полезность должна превосходить статический и question-only выбор глубины.

relations.note: Предлагаемое расширение фиксированной рекуррентной глубины; не результат исходной статьи и не выполненный эксперимент.

baselines: Random stopping at matched average cost
Oracle stopping upper bound, evaluation only
protocol.primary_metric: Measured wall-clock savings at predeclared accuracy non-inferiority margin; one answer attempt per question

budget.unit: USD planning envelope, not spending authorization

protocol.falsification: No measured advantage over fixed-depth/question-only Pareto frontier, or quality loss exceeds margin after accounting for uncertainty and gate overhead.
protocol.data: Candidate plan: 2000–5000 train/validation examples with automatic correctness checks; 1000–2000 held-out test questions across math and QA, with a separate domain-shift slice. Final manifests and decontamination not yet selected.
protocol.quality_gate: Before running: confirm exact model/adapter revisions and access, select immutable dataset manifests, calibrate 50–100-question pilot throughput, predeclare bootstrap/non-inferiority analysis and thresholds. Initial target: >=20% time saving and <=2 percentage point loss, not promised outcome.
protocol.frozen_components: All base LLMs and existing RecursiveLinks; train only a separate small stopping classifier.
protocol.gate_inputs: Observable hidden states before final answer decoding at a round boundary; no test labels or future-round states.
protocol.label_generation: Decode candidate answers for R=1/2/3 on training/validation examples; use correctness and measured cost as targets. Split by question before trace generation.
protocol.runtime_measurement: Actual dynamic execution, not replayed average-round count alone. Include gate/branching overhead and measure batch=1 plus a small batched setting. Warmup/loading reported separately.
protocol.success_criterion_note: Require confidence bounds to satisfy the chosen margin; small datasets may be inconclusive even if point estimates look favorable.
protocol.novelty: Not searched. No claim that adaptive stopping itself is new.

cost_estimate.pricing_scope: Public Secure Cloud/listed rates; deployed instance quote and availability can differ. No assumption that the cheapest Community instance is available.
cost_estimate.storage_note: Network volume below 1TB is $0.07/GB/month: 100GB for a full month is $7. Other container/volume disks may add charges. $10 is a planning allowance, not a fixed fee.
cost_estimate.memory_estimate: BF16 weights alone: ~8.4GB for Sequential-Light ~4.2B total parameters, ~22GB for Scaled ~11B. KV cache, activations, framework and batch overhead additional; peak memory not measured. 24GB Light feasibility is provisional; 80GB chosen for headroom.
main_uncertainties: Python inference implementation throughput and repeated loading
mean output length and long-tail questions
need for new data or additional test power

history.note: План согласован с фиксированной рекуррентной архитектурой и двухэтапным обучением RecursiveLinks: для пилота все компоненты основы заморожены, обучается только новый gate. Глубины и checkpoints проверяются пилотом; результаты отсутствуют, ready=false.
